root_causes.slow_search_button: The initial best-option discovery is awaited before ranking, but 1916/1917 showed no pending overlay during that wait.
root_causes.hang_at_88_percent: After POI progress reached 22/22, the app entered overnight-accommodation enrichment. It queried each overnight sequentially and could try two Overpass endpoints at 5.5 seconds each per night, so a five-day trip could sit visibly at 88% for tens of seconds.

changes.pending_screens: The same full-screen pending UI used for plan calculation now appears while 'Zoek mijn roadtrip' discovers and ranks options.
changes.image_flip: The 24 progress images rotate every 1000 ms in every operation using the pending overlay.
changes.accommodation_progress: Progress now advances from 88% to an explicit 89% accommodation stage and 94% final assembly.
changes.hang_prevention: Overnight lookups run in parallel, both mirrors are raced, per-request timeout is 4.2 s, and the entire stage has a 7 s watchdog. Timeout keeps the completed route/POI plan rather than blocking.
